title: Uncertainty-Aware Conflict Detection Against Operator-Conditioned Weather Hazards
description:
arXiv:2609.12095v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Strategic flight plan validation in Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) environments requires robust methods for predicting aircraft state uncertainty and detecting potential conflicts with dynamic airspace hazards. This paper presents a novel framework for uncertainty-conditioned trajectory prediction combined with polyhedra hazard representation for pre-flight conflict detection.
